notes.unknownSkills: All four remain neutral70; no new measured ballhandling, off-ball movement, screens or double-team escape data was obtained.
notes.speed: Missing. Spacing uses observed3PM/min and production/role proxies; it does not measure running speed or prove speed caused a shot-quality change.
notes.shooting: Source fresh FGM/FGA by zone with100-attempt league prior, retained shared league projection and actual fresh-FGA-weighted source context. Same-season reconstruction, not an independent forecast.
notes.assists: Source AST/min converted to delivery opportunities using source-implied receiver FG success; transport has no self-pass and conserves terminal opportunities. Success reference remains the earlier v18 approximation.
notes.turnovers: Source box turnover-skill ratio and measured pass-steal activity feed separate touch/pass processes. No dribbling tracking is available; neutral handle is not a measured dribbling grade.
notes.steals: Observed STL/min with240-minute league prior determines pressure/activity, independently of closest-defender FG contest ratings.
notes.blocks: Conditional blocked-miss recipient uses measured BLK/min; existing team blocked-miss mechanism retained. Allocation accuracy alone does not prove incremental team defense.
notes.rebounds: Existing team OREB probability retained; individual DREB recipient correction retained. Neither player shares nor team totals alone establish causal replacement value.
notes.contests: Closest-defended FGA/player-minute times conditional FG difference, divided by team-zone FGA/team-minute. Six-foot rim counts do not cover every short shot; midrange remains a proxy. Descriptive association, not causal defense.
notes.stamina: Exported grade is based on observed minutes per game. It is a role proxy, not measured physiology. Equal-duration OVR disables fatigue/substitution.
notes.physique: Height/weight derived percentile remains in separate shot/rebound mechanisms; v20 changes contest exposure, not the physique prior.
notes.ovr: One natural position, four distinct mean70 positional teammates,30 fixed opponent lineups, both seating orders,14.4 minutes. Auxiliary rates use declared positional pools. Current31-player sample is not a Top50 or an anchored0–99 rating.
